mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact removes the rule that every ClinicalNote must originate from a permitted PostNote op. The injection forces a note tied to a denied op, which violates the append-only invariant (notes only from permitted appends) and the no-leak-on-deny invariant (denied ops produce no side effects).
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some n: ClinicalNote | n.createdBy.outcome = Denied }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact removes the global rule that permitted ops must lie in the MayAttempt matrix. The injection forces a permitted ComplianceOfficer→GetRecord op, which is explicitly denied by the matrix and the spec — exactly what LeastPrivilege should catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeastPrivilegeViolation { some op: Operation | op.callerRole = ComplianceOfficer and op.kind = GetRecord and op.outcome = Permitted }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact removes the requirement that every Operation has a matching AuditEntry. The injection forces an Operation with no audit, violating FR-013's always-on auditing rule.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditCompletenessViolation { some op: Operation | (no ae: AuditEntry | ae.forOp = op) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact lets audit-entry fields diverge from the underlying operation. The injection forces an AuditEntry whose entryUser differs from its op's caller, violating FR-014's snapshot-fidelity requirement.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AttributionViolation { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.entryUser != ae.forOp.caller }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact removes the care-team predicate that gates clinician access. The injection forces a permitted clinician GetRecord op against a record for which no CareTeamMembership row exists — exactly the FR-004 violation pattern.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CareTeamViolation { some op: Operation | op.callerRole = Clinician and op.outcome = Permitted and op.kind = GetRecord and (no m: CareTeamMembership | m.member = op.caller and m.forRecord = op.target) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact removes the rule that a patient may only access their own assigned_record_id. The injection forces a permitted patient op targeting a record other than the caller's assignedRecord, violating FR-006.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PatientOwnViolation { some op: Operation | op.callerRole = Patient and op.outcome = Permitted and op.kind = GetRecord and op.caller.assignedRecord != op.target }
